name: code-complete
description: Steve McConnell's Code Complete as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for routine design, data meaning, control flow, defensive programming, testing, debugging and measured tuning.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Code Complete rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
